_comment: Compiled and published by had.sh (https://glyphs.had.sh). This file is a ground truth corpus: every value in it was observed in game and written down by a human player. Nothing here is generated, predicted or filled in by us, so the corpus can be used to score procedural generators without owing them anything. Read 'method' before using it, and 'codes' before comparing any *_code field to a prediction.
description: 1000 No Man's Sky star systems across 64 galaxies, 200 per star colour, recorded by hand by players on the community wiki. No value is computed, predicted or completed: this corpus exists to evaluate procedural generators, so it must owe them nothing.

source.name: No Man's Sky Wiki (Fandom), Cargo exports
source.licence: CC BY-SA 3.0, same as the wiki content it derives from
source.note: Player names of the discoverers are not carried over. Traceability goes through source_page.

method.address: derived from the portal coordinates (offsets 0x7FF on X and Z, 0x7F on Y), never from name resolution
method.address_confidence: summary of two independent checks: confirmed_twice = both the region name and the distance to the galactic centre agree, confirmed_once = only one of the two is available and it agrees, partially_contradicted = one of the two disagrees, contradicted_twice = both disagree, unverified = neither is available
method.galaxy: galaxy_index counts from 1 (Euclid = 1), galaxy_namegen counts from 0 (Euclid = 0), the convention used by the name generation library. Using the wrong one raises no error, it silently describes a different galaxy
method.duplicates: multiple records of one system are merged when they agree, and the system is dropped when they contradict each other on any published field
method.post_origins: the Origins update of 2020-09-23 regenerated the game universe: records older than that describe a universe the game no longer produces, and every system here is newer
method.empty: a field that was not recorded is null, never a default value
method.links: source_url points at the wiki article the record comes from, which is also the attribution required by the wiki licence. image_url, when present, points at our own copy of the system screenshot taken from that article; it is null for most systems because few wiki articles carry one
method.uncharted: an uninhabited system has no space station, so economy, wealth, conflict, buy_percent and sell_percent are null there because the game does not display them, not because the record is incomplete. 90% of the red-star systems in this corpus are in that case, against 0.1% of the yellow ones

codes._comment: Two-digit code. The family is the first digit unless it is 0, in which case it is the second: '01', '10', '11', '12' and '13' all mean family 1, and all match a prediction of 1. A code starting with 0 is the generic value of its family; the others are variants of that same family. See 'families' for the name of each family and 'values' for the label of each code. Never read the left digit on its own: on '01' it is 0, which is the code for unknown, and the mistake is silent because it still yields a valid code. '00' really does mean unknown or not applicable.

selection.rule: 200 systems per star colour, all post-Origins and with an address confirmed by both checks, the most complete records first. Ties are broken by a hash of the system address, so the draw is reproducible without favouring any galaxy or any region of the universe
